LatestVersion.ReleaseNotes: The textures are as close as possible to vanilla textures, but AI upscaled with lots of manual tweaks to get an HD experience of the original game design. This pack also upscales all of the field animations. Those animations can cause slowdown on some fields on some computers. If you get slowdown, please disable the "Advanced Texture Animations" option. (double click on this mod and turn off the "Advanced Texture Animations") To get proper Advanced Texture Animations you need to: -Be on the lastest updated 7th Heaven version from here: https://github.com/tsunamods-codes/7th-Heaven/releases. (Scroll down, click "Assets", and grab 7thHeaven-vxxx_Release.zip) -Then go in 7th "Settings/General Settings" and on the bottom-left you'll find the FFNx section, click canary then check for updates, say yes and then go to "Settings/Game Driver Settings, and click "Restore defaults" next to save. -Then go in 7th "Settings/Game Driver - Animated Textures" and set it to ON.
